items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: And I met her there and she always remembered I was from Tracy.

ctx.x: lived right in Chicago, she lived one block from me. My mother lives right near there now. But she was already a star and I didn't really know her. She was responsible for getting Jimmy Blanton in the band.

Really? That time I went down to Frisco she'd just started with the band. And I met her there and she always remembered I was from Tracy. And I saw her three years later and she said, Oh, hello, Tracy. And I used to follow her around like a hopeless sheepdog. I was crazy about her.
